name: Lead scoring with research
description: Your own scoring block rates each inbound lead with clear rules; for a hot lead an agent looks the company up with Python tools from the workspace and drafts a first email.

channels.description: The web form submission: name, email, company, role, company size and message

channels.name: score_reasons
channels.description: The points the lead got, and why

channels.name: structured_response
channels.description: The agent's research notes and drafted email

channels.name: next_step
channels.description: What happens to the lead now

values.next_step: Hot lead: outreach drafted for a sales rep to review and send.

config.system_prompt: You are a sales development rep. Before writing, look the company up with your tools: its profile, its recent news, and any earlier contact with us (by the domain of the lead's email). Use only facts from the tools or from the lead's own message; never invent any. Then draft a short, personal first email (under 120 words) that names their need, mentions one relevant fact you found, and proposes a 20-minute call this week.

research_notes.description: What the tools found, in two or three sentences

values.next_step: {{ state.tier | capitalize }} lead ({{ state.score }}/100): added to the nurture sequence, no email drafted.
